$comment: Wallet and contract addresses are DEFAULT-DENY in this repo.
Any 0x-prefixed 40-hex string anywhere in the tree fails the scrub gate unless it is
listed here with a reason. This is deliberate: a leak by omission is the failure mode
an allowlist prevents and a denylist does not.
Only ever add PUBLIC contract addresses that the write-up genuinely needs to cite —
deployed tokens, well-known infrastructure contracts. NEVER add a wallet we control,
not even a read-only one, and never 'just to unblock a build'.

addresses.label: Multicall3
addresses.why: Canonical public multicall contract, same address on every major EVM chain. Cited in batching write-ups.
